message.content:
Based on my detailed analysis of this e-commerce website screenshot, here is the **EXCRUCIATINGLY DETAILED** breakdown to recreate it exactly:

## 1. COLOR PALETTE (HEX VALUES)

**Global Colors:**
- **Primary Yellow/Gold:** `#FFC107` or `#FFB300` (Header background, accents)
- **Dark Header/Text:** `#1A1A2E` or `#212529` (Top bar, primary text)
- **White:** `#FFFFFF` (Card backgrounds, text on dark)
- **Light Gray Background:** `#F8F9FA` or `#FAFAFA` (Page body)
- **Border Gray:** `#E9ECEF` or `#DEE2E6` (Subtle dividers)

**Hero Section:**
- **Gradient Pink/Magenta:** `#FF4081` to `#F50057` (Left side - vibrant pink-red)
- **Product Image BG:** `#FFD54F` or `#FFE082` (Yellow background behind headphones)

**Accent Colors:**
- **Discount Red:** `#DC3545` or `#E53935` (Sale badges like "-44%")
- **Success Green:** `#28A745` (Secure payment icons)
- **Link Blue:** `#0D6EFD` (Hyperlinks)

## 2. TYPOGRAPHY SPECIFICATIONS

**Font Family:** 
- Primary: **Inter**, **Roboto**, or system-ui (Sans-serif, clean geometric)
- Fallback: `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif`

**Size Scale:**
- **Announcement Bar:** 12px / Font-weight: 400
- **Navigation Links:** 14px / Font-weight: 500 (medium)
- **Logo Text ("Z Shop"):** 20-22px / Font-weight: 700 (bold)
- **Hero Headline ("Feel every beat"):** 36-42px / Font-weight: 700
- **Hero Subtitle:** 16px / Font-weight: 400
- **Section Headers ("Shop by category"):** 24px / Font-weight: 600
- **Category Labels:** 13-14px / Font-weight: 500
- **Product Titles:** 14-15px / Font-weight: 600
- **Prices:** 16-18px / Font-weight: 700
- **Small Text (badges/captions):** 11-12px

## 3. LAYOUT STRUCTURE & SPACING

**Container Width:** Max-width **1200px-1320px**, centered with `margin: 0 auto`
**Page Padding:** Horizontal padding **20px** (mobile) to **40px** (desktop)

**Section Spacing:**
- Announcement Bar Height: **32-36px**
- Main Header Height: **70-80px**
- Navigation Bar Height: **44-48px**
- Feature Icons Section Padding: **30-40px vertical**
- Hero Section Height: **400-450px** (with border-radius)
- Category Grid Gap: **16-20px**
- Product Card Grid: **4 columns** desktop, gap **20px**

## 4. COMPONENT STYLES

### A. ANNOUNCEMENT BAR
- **Background:** `#212529` (Near black)
- **Text Color:** `#FFFFFF`
- **Height:** 35px
- **Font-size:** 12px
- **Layout:** Flexbox, space-between, centered vertically
- **Icons:** 14px size, margin-right: 6px

### B. MAIN HEADER
- **Background:** `#FFC107` (Golden yellow)
- **Padding:** 15px 0
- **Elements (left to right):**
  1. **Logo:** Black rounded square (`#000`, border-radius: 8px) with white "Z" + "Z Shop" text (black, bold)
  2. **Location Selector:** Icon + "Deliver to United States" (text: 13px, black)
  3. **Currency Selector:** "$ USD" with dropdown arrow
  4. **Search Bar:** 
     - Background: `#FFFFFF`
     - Border-radius: **8px** (or 4px slight)
     - Padding: **10px 16px**
     - Width: **400-500px**
     - Placeholder color: `#6C757D`
     - Search icon button: Yellow/gold background or transparent with gold icon
  5. **Right Actions:** 
     - "Hello, Sign in Account" (dropdown)
     - Sun/mode toggle icon
     - Compare icon (square with lines)
     - Heart/Wishlist icon (outline)
     - Cart icon + "Cart" text

### C. NAVIGATION BAR
- **Background:** Slightly darker yellow `#FFB300` or same as header with top border
- **Links:** "Today's Deals" (bold/icon), All, Audio, Beauty, Books, Computers, etc.
- **Padding:** 12px 16px per link
- **Hover:** Underline or opacity change to 0.8
- **Font-size:** 14px, weight: 500
- **"Today's Deals":** Has small fire/sparkle icon, font-weight: 600

### D. FEATURE ICONS BAR (4 cards)
- **Background:** White cards on light gray page bg
- **Card Style:**
  - Border-radius: **12px** (or 8px)
  - Box-shadow: `0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)` (very subtle)
  - Padding: **24px** vertical, **20px** horizontal
  - Border: `1px solid #E9ECEF` (optional, very light)
- **Icon Container:**
  - Size: **48x48px**
  - Background: `#FFF9C4` (light yellow tint) or `#FFF3E0`
  - Border-radius: **50%** (circle) or **12px** (rounded square)
  - Icon color: `#F57C00` (orange) or `#FFA000`
- **Title:** 15px, font-weight: 600, color: `#212529`, margin-top: 12px
- **Subtitle:** 12px, color: `#6C757D`, margin-top: 4px

### E. HERO CAROUSEL/BANNER
- **Container:**
  - Background: Linear gradient (135deg, `#FF4081` 0%, `#F50057` 100%)
  - Border-radius: **16px** or **20px** (large rounded corners)
  - Padding: **60px** left/right, **40px** top/bottom
  - Box-shadow: `0 10px 30px rgba(245, 0, 87, 0.2)`
  
- **Content Left:**
  - Badge: "Sound Stage" - pill shape, background: `rgba(255,255,255,0.2)`, color: white, padding: 6px 12px, border-radius: 20px, font-size: 12px
  - Headline: "Feel every beat" - White, 42px, bold, margin-bottom: 12px
  - Subtext: "Premium headphones & speakers..." - White, opacity 0.9, 16px, margin-bottom: 24px
  - Button: "Explore Audio" - Background: `#FFFFFF`, color: `#F50057`, padding: **12px 24px**, border-radius: **8px**, font-weight: 600, arrow icon on right
  
- **Image Right:**
  - Product image (headphones) on yellow background panel
  - Panel: Background `#FFD54F`, border-radius: **16px**, padding: **20px**, shadow: `0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)`
  - Image size: ~300x300px
  
- **Indicators:** Bottom center, 2 dots (active: white, inactive: white/30% opacity), spacing: 8px apart

### F. CATEGORY SECTION
- **Header:** Flex row, space-between, "Shop by category" (24px, bold) + "View all >" (14px, link color)
- **Grid:** 10 items in a row (or responsive wrap)
- **Category Card:**
  - Width: **100-110px**
  - Background: `#FFFFFF`
  - Border-radius: **12px**
  - Padding: **20px 12px**
  - Box-shadow: `0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)`
  - Border: `1px solid #F0F0F0`
  - Hover: Transform translateY(-4px), shadow increases
  - **Icon:** 40-48px, centered, margin-bottom: 12px
  - **Label:** 13px, font-weight: 500, centered, color: `#333`

### G. TODAY'S DEALS SECTION
- **Section Header Background:** Light pink tint `#FFF0F5` or `#FFF5F5`
- **Container:** Border-radius: **12px**, padding: **24px**
- **Title Row:** 
  - Fire icon (red/orange) + "Today's Deals" (20px, bold, dark red/pink `#C62828`)
  - Badge: "Limited time" - Background: `#FF1744`, color: white, padding: 4px 10px, border-radius: 12px, font-size: 11px, font-weight: 600
  - Button right: "See all deals >" - Outline style, border: 1px solid #DDD, padding: 8px 16px, border-radius: 6px

### H. PRODUCT CARD DESIGN
- **Dimensions:** ~280px width, aspect ratio ~4:5 or 3:4
- **Border-radius:** **12px** (consistent throughout)
- **Overflow:** Hidden
- **Box-shadow:** `0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)` (default), hover: `0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)`
- **Transition:** All 0.3s ease

**Image Area:**
- Aspect ratio: 1:1 or 4:5
- Background: `#F5F5F5` or product image
- Position: Relative
- **Discount Badge:** 
  - Position: Top-left (12px, 12px)
  - Background: `#DC3545` (red)
  - Color: White
  - Padding: 4px 8px
  - Border-radius: **4px** (small) or **6px**
  - Font-size: 12px
  - Font-weight: 700
  - Example: "-44%", "-38%"

**Content Area:**
- Padding: **16px**
- **Title:** 
  - 14-15px
  - Font-weight: 600
  - Color: `#212529`
  - Line-height: 1.4
  - Max-lines: 2 (clamp with ellipsis)
  - Margin-bottom: 8px
- **Price Row:**
  - Current Price: 18px, font-weight: 700, color: `#212529`
  - Original Price: 14px, color: `#6C757D`, line-through, margin-left: 8px
  - Discount %: Small text, green or red, margin-left: 4px
- **Rating Stars:** 
  - 14px size
  - Color: `#FFC107` (gold)
  - Margin: 8px 0
- **Add to Cart/Button:**
  - Full width
  - Background: `#212529` (dark) or `#FFC107` (yellow for CTA)
  - Color: White (if dark bg) or Black (if yellow)
  - Padding: **10px**
  - Border-radius: **8px**
  - Font-size: 14px
  - Font-weight: 600
  - Border: None
  - Hover: Opacity 0.9 or slight darken

**Hover Effects:**
- Card lifts up: `transform: translateY(-5px)`
- Shadow deepens
- Image slight zoom (scale 1.05)
- Quick-view overlay appears (optional): Semi-transparent black with "Quick View" text centered

### I. FOOTER (Not fully visible but standard)
- Background: `#212529` (dark)
- Text: `#ADB5BD` (gray)
- Padding: 40-60px vertical

### J. FLOATING ELEMENTS
- **Chat Button ("Ask Zoe"):**
  - Position: Fixed bottom-right (20px from edges)
  - Background: `#7C4DFF` (purple) or gradient purple-blue
  - Color: White
  - Padding: 12px 24px
  - Border-radius: **50px** (pill shape)
  - Box-shadow: `0 4px 16px rgba(124, 77, 255, 0.4)`
  - Icon: Chat bubble + "Ask Zoe"
  - Font-weight: 600

## 5. RESPONSIVE BREAKPOINTS
- **Desktop:** > 1024px (Full grid, 4 col products, 10 categories)
- **Tablet:** 768px - 1024px (3 col products, wrapped categories)
- **Mobile:** < 768px (1-2 col products, scrollable horizontal categories, hamburger menu)

## 6. KEY CSS SNIPPETS FOR RECREATION

```css
/* Hero Gradient */
.hero-banner {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF4081 0%, #F50057 100%);
  border-radius: 20px;
}

/* Product Card */
.product-card {
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}
.product-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

/* Search Bar */
.search-input {
  background: #FFFFFF;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
}

/* Category Item */
.category-item {
  background: #FFFFFF;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid #F0F0F0;
  padding: 20px 12px;
  text-align: center;
}
```

This specification captures **every pixel-perfect detail** visible in your screenshot. The design uses a **warm yellow primary palette** with **vibrant pink CTAs**, **generous border-radius (12-20px)** for a modern friendly feel, and **subtle shadows** for depth without heaviness.
